coach.name: Tod Kowalczyk
coach.notes: Overall record 451-323 and 315-211 at Toledo entering 2026-27 (per Wikipedia 2026-27 MAC season page); 177-108 MAC record with five MAC regular-season titles; Toledo reached the 2026 MAC Championship Game. Previously head coach at Wisconsin-Green Bay (eight seasons). Has not reached the NCAA Tournament as Toledo coach; Mid-Major Madness calls him 'arguably the best mid-major coach to have never made the NCAA Tournament.' A HoopDirt headline seen in search results says he received a contract extension through 2027-28 (not verified, page not read). Staff: associate head coaches Justin Ingram and Jeff Massey; assistants Jordan Lauf and Brandon Pritzl (also GM); director of player development Brett Rau. Hosts a coach's show at Stubborn Brother Pizza Bar on select Mondays 6-7 p.m. starting Nov. 9, 2026.

previews.title: Men's Basketball Q&A with Head Coach Tod Kowalczyk
previews.summary: Kowalczyk says Toledo returns six rotation players, which he calls a lot 'in this day and age,' and added three veteran transfers (each with two years of eligibility) and four freshmen. He says last year's team was 'probably too young' after signing five freshmen before revenue sharing changed recruiting, so the staff prioritized experience. Marquette transfer Sean Jones was the first portal signing and has been installed as starting point guard. He expects Jaylan Ouwinga to become one of the league's best post players if consistent and says Austin Parks improved through last season. Some freshmen will need time to develop.

previews.title: 2026-27 MAC Men's Basketball Preview
previews.author: Sam Federman
previews.summary: Federman's conference preview lists Toledo third in order (after Kent State and Miami) without numbered projections. He credits Kowalczyk's long record of producing excellent guards and calls him arguably the best mid-major coach never to make the NCAA Tournament. Toledo's ceiling is said to depend mainly on Marquette transfer Sean Jones regaining his pre-knee-injury form, with Providence transfer Rich Barron and UMass Lowell transfer Angel Montas Jr. as other key pieces and Austin Parks and Jaylan Ouwinga returning in the frontcourt. Canonical URL: https://www.midmajormadness.com/mid-american-conference/37312/2026-27-mac-mens-basketball-preview

previews.title: 2026-27 Mid-American Conference men's basketball season
previews.projected_finish: 2nd of 12 in MAC preseason coaches poll (117 points, 2 first-place votes)
previews.summary: Toledo was picked second behind Miami (133 points, 9 first-place votes) in the MAC preseason coaches poll, ahead of Akron (110) and Kent State (108, 1 first-place vote). Sean Jones (G, R-Sr.) and Austin Parks (C, Sr.) were named Preseason All-MAC Second Team; Toledo had no first-team selections. The conference moved to a 22-game round-robin schedule and the 2027 MAC Tournament remains at Rocket Arena in Cleveland. Kowalczyk enters his 17th season with a 315-211 record at Toledo.

previews.title: Games at Michigan and Michigan State Highlight Toledo's 2026-27 Non-Conference Schedule
previews.summary: Schedule release: Nov 2 at Arkansas State (MAC-SBC Challenge), Nov 5 at Michigan State, Nov 7 at Marshall, Nov 10 vs Wright State (home opener), Nov 14 at Detroit Mercy, Nov 19 vs Robert Morris, Nov 28 at Valparaiso, Dec 16 vs Oakland, Dec 30 at Michigan, Feb 6 MAC-SBC Challenge. Non-conference opponents went a combined 199-105 (.655) last season, described as the toughest non-league slate in program history. Kowalczyk: 'It will be an opportunity to test ourselves against the best in the country.'

storylines.headline: Picked second in the MAC with two preseason All-MAC second-teamers
storylines.detail: Toledo received 117 points and two first-place votes behind Miami; Sean Jones and Austin Parks made the preseason second team.

storylines.headline: Veteran portal class replaces a 'too young' 2025-26 roster
storylines.detail: Kowalczyk added Sean Jones (Marquette), Rich Barron (Providence) and Angel Montas Jr. (UMass Lowell), each with two years of eligibility, after admitting the five-freshman 2025 class left the team too young.

storylines.headline: Toughest non-conference schedule in program history
storylines.detail: Opponents combined for a 199-105 record last season, including road trips to Michigan State (Nov 5) and Michigan (Dec 30).

storylines.headline: Austin Parks injury
storylines.detail: Preseason All-MAC center Austin Parks did not play at Michigan State on Nov 5 due to injury; his status for the Marshall game and beyond was not confirmed in pages read.

storylines.headline: 0-2 start before first win at Marshall
storylines.detail: One-point loss at Arkansas State, 30-point loss at No. 6 Michigan State, then an 81-76 road win at Marshall on Nov 7 with Montas and Strong each scoring 20 (AP).

storylines.headline: Kowalczyk's NCAA Tournament drought
storylines.detail: Mid-Major Madness frames Kowalczyk as the best mid-major coach never to reach the NCAA Tournament; Toledo lost in the 2026 MAC title game.

players_in_coverage.name: Sean Jones
players_in_coverage.notes: 5-10, Columbus, Ohio (Gahanna Lincoln). Starting point guard; preseason All-MAC second team. Debut at Arkansas State: career-high 9 assists, 2 turnovers in 33 minutes. 9 points at Michigan State. Mid-Major Madness says ceiling depends on him regaining pre-knee-injury form.

recent_news.headline: Toledo drops opener 71-70 at Arkansas State
recent_news.detail: Tameron Ferguson's free throw with 4 seconds left won it for ASU after Ouwinga tied it at 70. Strong 18 pts/4 stl; Ouwinga 16 pts/14 reb; Montas 16/10 off bench in debut; Jones 9 assists. Toledo shot 6-27 from three and committed 16 turnovers.

recent_news.headline: No. 6 Michigan State routs Toledo 91-61
recent_news.detail: Toledo trailed 48-25 at half and was outrebounded 52-27. Strong 11, Ouwinga 10, Jones 9, Porter 9. Austin Parks sat out with an injury. Starters: Ouwinga, Riddle, Strong, Montas, Jones.
